playwright_spec.description: Complete @playwright/test spec file (TypeScript) reproducing every verified step

vault_update.description: Vault note path + row/field changed when a tracked feature_key was verified, per Skill - E2E Feature Verification; null if no vault tracking was requested

ui_ux_notes.description: Observations on visual design, clarity of labeling/copy, consistency with the rest of the admin UI, empty/loading/error states, and any usability friction encountered — beyond pass/fail functional correctness. Null only if there was truly nothing to observe (e.g. navigation failed before any UI rendered).
